action_items.detail: JRN-150: Inbox has no Gmail bar in the anonymous demo. GmailBar.jsx returns null unless Gmail is connected or expired, so this looks intended. The Inbox page and list load. Check that the spec agrees.

JRN-143: clicking a Fleet legend item opens the van page. Selection (lime route plus glow, others dimmed) happens on hover/focus or a van-icon click. The rail also opens the van page. The check used hover.
JRN-145: the chips have no Day used chip. The card's Day used (492 of 540 min, 91%) matches Spare 48 (540-492=48), and Spare matches the chip (48).

Browser checks use the preview URL: localhost:3000 calls the preview API and fails on CORS because of the credentials plus wildcard origin. The regression check ran Optimize, Apply and Undo on seeded Van 2. Undo restored it, and the demo was reset afterwards.
